title: Fish, noodles, and vegetables without carrots, broccoli, and dark-green leafy; cheese sauce

content.title: About
content.content: The dish consists of boiled or pan‑fried fish, egg or wheat noodles, and a mix of vegetables (such as bell pepper, zucchini, peas), deliberately excluding carrots, broccoli and dark‑green leafy greens. All components are coated with a smooth cheese sauce made from milk, cheese and seasonings.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Combining fish and cheese is a classic feature of Mediterranean cuisine.
Noodles readily absorb the flavor of the sauce, making the dish more robust.
Leaving out carrots and broccoli makes the meal lighter for sensitive stomachs.
Cheese sauce is often prepared with processed cheese, which melts easily and gives a velvety texture.
Variations may replace fish with seafood such as shrimp.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Fish provides high‑quality protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Omega‑3 fatty acids
items.content: Fatty fish like salmon or mackerel contain omega‑3s that support cardiovascular health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Noodles and vegetables supply B1, B2 and B6 vitamins important for metabolism.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: The cheese sauce adds calcium, beneficial for bone and teeth health.

items.title: Low added sugar
items.content: The dish contains no added sugars, making it suitable for blood‑glucose control.

items.title: Fish or dairy allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to fish or dairy may experience adverse reactions.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Cheese sauces often contain salt; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Possible contaminants in fish
items.content: Some fish species may contain mercury; choose young or low‑mercury varieties.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Cheese sauce made from milk can cause discomfort for those with lactose intolerance.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dish hot, drizzling the cheese sauce over the fish and noodles just before serving. Garnish with fresh herbs such as parsley or dill for extra aroma. Optionally sprinkle grated Parmesan or add a lemon wedge.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared dish in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. Store the cheese sauce separately and reheat before use to prevent fat separation.
